The Bosch research team in Beijing maintains close collaborations with Tsinghua University and other leading academic institutions to access cutting-edge research and top talent. These partnerships enable the acceleration of early-stage innovation in areas such as machine learning, perception systems, and AI applications for mobility and industry.

Furthermore, the Pittsburgh team drives Bosch’s long-term research collaboration with Carnegie Mellon University (CMU), one of the world’s leading AI research institutes. This collaboration helps ensure Bosch’s competitive edge in this rapidly evolving technology area.
